summary: Oncolytics Biotech filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 on September 29, 2026, furnishing a press release disclosing publication of preclinical/academic data in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences on September 28, 2026. The paper describes how pelareorep converts an immunologically inactive hepatocellular carcinoma tumor microenvironment into an immunologically active phenotype potentially susceptible to immunotherapy. No securities transaction, corporate action, or strategic event is disclosed. The filing carries no deal terms, no board recommendation, no advisor, and no regulatory clock; the arb-relevant risk is ordinary clinical/regulatory execution risk, not a special situation.
